subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary : The main purpose of the author of this passage is to express the theme of our Liberation War. Freedom is the birth right of man but sometimes this right is denied to a nation by foreign forces. The people of Bangladesh fought against the Pakistani army and finally won. This was a war of freedom. Many of the freedom fighters sacrificed their lives for the causes of the motherland. All walks of people are indebted to them. They are the golden sons of Bangladesh and her Made Easy to SSC English Test Papers Firstly, English has been the medium of communication throughout the world. Business, official correspondence contact with foreigner, everything is completely dependent upon English. Without the knowledge of English you cannot get any good job. Secondly, English is the gateway to higher studies. Almost all the books of science, medicine, information technology English literature and many other subjects are written in English. If you don't have good efficiency in English you cannot have good result. Thirdly, sound knowledge in English is the pre-condition for the students to have the access to foreign university. You cannot have good score in TOEFL or IELTS, which is a must for admission in foreign universities, unless you have profound understanding in English. I believe by now you have understood the necessity of English. So keep on learning in the right method. Your loving brother, Muhib
